evidence.why: Captures the certificate a host presents and saves it as a per-host PEM under trusted_certs (trust on first use).
Explicitly configured CA bundle overrides the pinned per-host certificate, which in turn overrides default certifi verification.
Wraps requests calls to auto-pin and retry on trust-chain SSL errors, skipping recovery when a CA bundle is configured.
Restricts auto-trust to self-signed/missing-issuer trust-chain failures rather than all TLS errors.
